sentences.en: Lithium ion batteries are used in almost all electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 锂离子电池几乎被用在所有电动汽车中。

sentences.en: The computer whose keyboard was bought by Ion was locked.
sentences.zh: 伊翁买的键盘那台电脑被锁了。

sentences.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge.
sentences.zh: 离子是一种带有净电荷的原子或分子。
